facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition, through SPIVTEN, opened a national situational-analysis workshop on 27 August 2025 for the national AI action plan, bringing together public institutions, the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and technical and financial partners in thematic sub-groups whose conclusions feed the draft plan.
facts.system: National AI action plan (Plan d'action national sur l'intelligence artificielle) 2026-2028
